title: Netskope + Entra ID SSO & Identity-Based Policy Enforcement
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (IdP integration: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + identity-steered policy between Netskope and Entra ID).
Distinct from conditional-access-integration (Entra CA): this product integrates Netskope with Entra ID as IdP and enforces identity-based SSE policy.
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: Make every Netskope policy follow the user — via Entra ID single sign-on
problem: Network-security policy that isn't tied to identity is blunt: you can't write rules per user or group, and admins juggle separate logins. This solution integrates Netskope with Microsoft Entra ID for SSO and identity-based policy — SAML single sign-on for admins and users, SCIM user/group provisioning, and policies that steer and enforce by identity and group, so the right controls follow the right people everywhere.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the IdP integration model, SAML SSO, SCIM user/group provisioning into Netskope, identity-based steering and policy, and how it complements (not duplicates) Entra Conditional Access.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant, Entra ID with the rights to register apps/SCIM, user/group structure, the Netskope client, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: configure SAML SSO between Entra ID and Netskope, enable SCIM provisioning, map groups, build identity-based steering and policy, validate sign-in and policy targeting, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — SSO/SCIM-readiness discovery, sign-in and provisioning validation, an identity-policy coverage report, safe remediation of provisioning gaps, and an identity-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Integrate Netskope with Microsoft Entra ID for SSO and identity-based policy — SAML single sign-on, SCIM user/group provisioning, and policies that steer and enforce by identity and group, so the right controls follow the right people. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
